register_model: register a new model class to the fairchem registry using the register_model decorator with a unique name key
register_dataset: register a new dataset class to the fairchem registry using the register_dataset decorator with a unique name key
register_task: register a new task class to the fairchem registry using the register_task decorator with a unique name key
get_class: get a registered class from the registry by name and mapping type or by fully qualified import path
register_and_get_state: register an arbitrary object in the registry state store and retrieve it later using dot-separated keys
